alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

logs: EVENT Killing Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-5xkkh: Container checkout failed liveness probe, will be restarted
EVENT Killing Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-c2ql8: Container checkout failed liveness probe, will be restarted
EVENT Unhealthy Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-5xkkh: Liveness probe failed:
EVENT Unhealthy Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-c2ql8: Liveness probe failed:
EVENT BackOff Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-c2ql8: Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-d79bb5b85-c2ql8_warden-pg(<UUID_1>)
EVENT BackOff Pod/checkout-d79bb5b85-5xkkh: Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-d79bb5b85-5xkkh_warden-pg(<UUID_2>)

root_cause.hypothesis: Deploy of revision 10 (python:3.12-alpine → 3.12.7-alpine) exposed/triggered a liveness-probe crashloop, most likely due to the very low memory_limit_mib (48) starving the container during startup and causing slow/unresponsive health checks rather than an actual OOM kill. Liveness probe failures triggered repeated restarts (restart_count 14, crashloop_containers 2, pods_ready 0), with later log lines showing the app does eventually report healthy/heartbeat, suggesting the app itself is functional but starts too slowly or intermittently under the tight memory ceiling for the probe's timing to tolerate.
evidence: Deploy at 2026-09-24T13:42:45Z changed image right before crashloop onset
memory_limit_mib=48 is unusually low for a Python image
oom_killed_containers=0 rules out hard OOM kill, points to probe/timing issue not memory exhaustion kill
restart_count=14 and crashloop_containers=2 with pods_ready=0 show sustained instability
BackOff + Unhealthy/Killing events explicitly cite liveness probe failure as restart trigger
Later log lines (13:48-49) show 'started, healthy' / 'heartbeat ok', meaning app can reach healthy state, inconsistent with pure app breakage
ruled_out: Total app failure/crash bug (logs show successful healthy starts on same pods)

proposal.reasoning: Crashloop started right after revision 10 deploy (3.12-alpine -> 3.12.7-alpine), correlation in time tight, no other config/infra change in window. Memory ceiling (48Mi) suspicious but wasn't changed by this deploy, so not root cause of the regression itself, deploy is. Liveness probe fails before app reports healthy; rollback removes the variable that changed.
proposal.expected_effect: New pods roll out on prior known-good image, pass liveness probe, pods_ready returns to 2/2, restarts stop.
